title: Platform S "S+" refactor — pluggable upload/watermark/sign/certify services
description:
## Context

From 2026-05-25: refactor Platform S toward an **"S+" model** where `upload`, `watermark`, `sign`, `certify` become distinct, **composable, pluggable services** — not role-bound (removes the rigid issuer-vs-user distinction). **"certify" = a non-mutating on-chain metadata event.**

Kam's steer: **reuse existing K workflows + document templates as the foundation**, not from scratch.

Platform S repo (`platform-s`). Ref: `Notes (MASTER)/Secuura/platform-s-k-strategy-and-roadmap.md`. Transcript §System Refactoring and Architecture (\~01:17), §Certify (\~01:05–01:08).
